description: An object unified with a map fails when its attributes don't convert to the type they unify to
notes: The spec unifies a map and an object by preferring the object type, which the map converts to here, so the result is the object. hashicorp/hcl unifies them to a map of lists of strings, which the object converts to on its own (convert({a = ["x"], b = s}, map(list(string))) succeeds), but unifyObjectsAsMaps in go-cty's cty/convert/unify.go first converts the object to a map of the type its own attributes unify to, a set of numbers, which fails because "x" isn't a number.
